title: Rust: Circuit Breaker Pattern
description: Implement the circuit breaker pattern for fault-tolerant systems.

steps.title: Define Circuit States
steps.description: Define an enum `CircuitState` with variants `Closed`, `Open`, `HalfOpen`. Create a `CircuitBreaker` struct with `failure_count`, `failure_threshold`, and `state`. Print the initial state.
hints: Track failures to trigger state transitions.

verification.failureMessage: Create a CircuitBreaker and print its initial state.

steps.title: Failure Tracking
steps.description: Add a `record_failure(&mut self)` method that increments failure_count. When failure_count >= threshold, transition to Open. Add a `record_success(&mut self)` to reset failures. Test triggering open state.
hints: `fn record_failure(&mut self) { self.failure_count += 1; if self.failure_count >= self.threshold { self.state = CircuitState::Open; } }`

verification.failureMessage: Record 3 failures to trip the circuit breaker and print states.

steps.title: Call Protection
steps.description: Add a `call<F, T>(&mut self, f: F) -> Result<T, String>` method. If state is Open, return without calling f. If Closed, call f, handle success/failure. Test with a function that sometimes fails.
hints: Call f, on success record success and return Ok, on failure record failure.
After threshold failures, subsequent calls are blocked.

verification.failureMessage: Trip the circuit breaker and show that calls are blocked.

steps.title: Half-Open Reset
steps.description: Add a `reset_timeout: Duration`. After being Open for the timeout duration, transition to HalfOpen. In HalfOpen, allow one trial call. On success, transition to Closed. On failure, back to Open.
hints: In `call`, if state is Open and timeout passed, transition to HalfOpen.
In HalfOpen, make the trial call. Success → Closed, Failure → Open.

verification.failureMessage: Demonstrate the Open → HalfOpen → Closed transition.

steps.title: Full Circuit Breaker Demo
steps.description: Simulate a complete scenario: 5 calls to an unstable service (first 3 fail, then 2 succeed after reset). Print the state and result of each call.
hints: Alternate between success and failure calls.
Show: 2 OK → 3 fails → circuit opens → timeout → 1 trial OK → circuit closes → 2 more OK.

verification.failureMessage: Run the scenario and print all states and results.
